title: The Brave Knights of St. John
author: Admin
excerpt: Learn about the courageous Knights of St. John who protected Malta and left behind amazing castles and stories!
content:
Long ago, over 500 years ago, Malta was protected by a group of brave knights called the Knights of St. John. They came from many countries in Europe and worked together to defend the island and help people in need. 🏰⚔️

  • Who were the Knights? They were soldiers and helpers who followed rules of courage, kindness, and faith. They built hospitals, forts, and churches all over Malta.
  • The Great Siege: In 1565, the Knights defended Malta from a huge army that tried to take over the island. Even though they were outnumbered, the Knights and Maltese people worked together and won!
  • Amazing buildings: The Knights built beautiful forts, palaces, and churches. One famous place is St. John’s Co-Cathedral in Valletta, which is full of colorful paintings and golden decorations. 🎨✨
  • Legacy: Today, the streets, forts, and buildings the Knights left behind help people learn about Malta’s history and brave heroes.

The story of the Knights of St. John teaches us about courage, teamwork, and helping others. Maybe one day, you’ll visit Malta and see the forts and palaces where history came alive! 🇲🇹
